removed_uncertainties.text: Line 7: is the second letter of מִטּוּל a ט or a מ with dagesh (מִמּוּל)? Is the last word שַׂלְמָה or שַׁלְמָה?
Line 9: vowels under ב in לוּבָשׁ and לָבָשׁ (qamats or tsere).
Line 10: whether כַּיְרִיעָה has a sheva and/or meteg under the yod.
Line 13: final הַשָּׁמָֽיִם: qamats or patah under מ.
Line 14: לָבְשָׁה is read from the image (qamats under ל, sheva under ב). Both drafts had other readings.
Line 16: dagesh in the first לּוֹ.
Line 19: spelling כְּתוֹנֶת (plene vav or not). Also whether וּלְתִפְאָרֶת has qamats or segol under א.
Line 22: whether וְגָדְלוּ has a meteg under ג.
Metegs in the small-type lines are only partly verified.
Meteg under ב in יְבָֽרְכוּכָה looks present but is not certain.
